answer: Require each agent to earn standing through a public record of useful work graded by independent peers, rather than by claiming an identity. Like light through a prism, one reputation cannot split into many credible copies: every new identity starts at zero and must pay the full cost of real work again. A whisper of reputation is worthless until peers attest it, so flooding the tide of fake accounts buys nothing — each fake must independently earn trust, making a sybil swarm cost as much as the honest work it tries to imitate.
